findings.evidence: BergmanCochains.lean:112 defines uniform_lift; the proofs at lines 57 and 84 merely repeat h.2 and h.2 D.constantCocycle, with hne copied into the latter bundle.
findings.fix: Delete both helpers and apply DiscCover.uniform_lift directly in the sphere and disconnected examples, specializing its lifting function to constantCocycle.
findings.issue: Both uniform_lift_selected and uniform_lift_constantCocycle (line 60) duplicate DiscCover.uniform_lift by bundling its universal conclusion with one specialization and, respectively, an input hypothesis.

findings.evidence: middleProjection is a continuous linear map (BergmanCochains.lean:322); Mathlib/Algebra/Module/LinearMap/Defs.lean:317 confirms map_zero, and Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Group/Basic.lean:138 supplies norm_zero.
findings.fix: Use the zero compatible triple directly: exact ⟨0, map_zero _, norm_zero⟩.
findings.issue: DiscCover.zero_lift invokes uniform lifting and reconstructs the zero norm through inequalities, duplicating map_zero and norm_zero and unnecessarily depending on the analytic lifting theorem.

summary: The example helpers duplicate the uniform lifting API through redundant conjunction bundles, and the zero-lift proof re-derives standard linear-map facts.
